83: He made a party, etc.: It refers back to several matters - to appease her, such that she reveal her heritage. But it did not help. And adjacent to this verse (Esther 2:19-20), "And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, etc. Esther did not reveal her heritage or her people, etc." - is that he made a banquet party in her honor, which he did not do for the other wives.
He lowered the taxes: He said, "On account of Esther, I am foregoing the head taxes from you." That is, "he instituted a reprieve" (Esther 2:18).
He sent pardishenei: Gifts to the ministers in her name. And that is that which is written, "and gave gratuities as befits a king."
